summary: Aeternum Health filed an 8-K disclosing a Sept. 21, 2026 Membership Interest Purchase Agreement to acquire all membership interests in American Renaissance Minerals LLC, holder of the right to acquire the Nkamouna nickel-cobalt project in Cameroon, from American Renaissance Resources LLC. Consideration is up to 133,333,333 pre-split common shares, or pre-funded warrants if a beneficial ownership cap applies, issued in stages against project milestones, a milestone-based, mostly stock deal. An accompanying Investor Rights Agreement grants ARR board observer rights and registration rights, contingent on holding over 9.9% of registrable securities. Watch milestone satisfaction, ownership dilution, and any 9.9% cap implications.
